notes: Matched ChIP-seq/RNA-seq; only RNA-seq samples are candidates. The shared treatment_protocol (1% formaldehyde cross-linking) is the ChIP step; RNA was harvested with RNAProtect, so treatment is set to none. Minimal+LIV (three added amino acids) fits neither defined_minimal nor defined_rich cleanly: medium_class and amino_acids_supplied left out for those samples. Oxygen and culture mode (shaking) not described. WT re-read: wild-type samples of the plain standard strain set to wild_type.
